C0863.title: .wxx Ransomware Attackers Adopt Double/Triple Extortion Tactics
C0863.summary: As of June 7, 2025, attackers behind the .wxx ransomware have adopted a double extortion strategy, threatening to publicly leak stolen data in addition to encrypting files. They have even escalated to triple extortion, threatening to disrupt the victim's infrastructure to increase payment pressure. The attackers operate through a Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) model, making attacks more widespread

references.title: Don't Let .wxx Ransomware Destroy Your Data: Recovery Tips and Prevention Advice
